d: We are currently seeking highly experienced and dedicated Registered Nurses with specialized clinical experience in Endoscopy and Transplant to join our healthcare team.

Responsible for providing comprehensive nursing care utilizing the nursing process and meeting the established standards of nursing practice and performance. Demonstrates leadership competencies while in charge or acting as shift resource/team leader.
